svg.text: Assess → Plan → Execute → Verify → Roll out · the integrator plans waves and converges results; subagents do the work
/update burndown — from transition log + story points
Phase 1 · ASSESS — scope, measurable criteria, baselines
Else user gives ID, or waive.
Phase 2 · PLAN — design artifact + living plan doc (waves of sized units)
Phase 3 · EXECUTE — per-wave loop: fan out → converge → verify
Never commit on red; stay in
Phase 4 · VERIFY — independent, repeated, on the integration branch
Remediation wave loops back through Execute, then re-verify
Phase 5 · ROLL OUT — deliver, post-MR E2E, review feedback, closeout
retry; if still red stop and
